name: stage_1_stand_permissive
description:
Permissive standing — trapezoid reward, no walking-derived rewards. Auto-advance after 30 sec CUMULATIVE upright (1800 ticks @ 60 Hz). Threshold deliberately permissive so distance signal becomes the dominant metric early in the 25-min tabula-rasa run.

This curriculum was created for the hierarchical-EPM experiment (Phase 7.2-EPM) — simplification of picrawler_stand_then_walk.json with the explicit goal of getting walking-reward injected within the first few minutes of every tabula-rasa run so cross-arm distance differentials are observable in 25-min budgets.

Walking-derived rewards explicitly zeroed.

name: stage_2_walk_radial_terminal
description:
Terminal stage. Inject small RADIAL-OUTWARD walking reward on top of standing — same shape as stage_3_walk_at_all in picrawler_stand_then_walk.json but no advance_when (stay here for the rest of the run).

v_norm = clamp(v_xz · r̂ / walk_target_velocity, 0, 1) — only motion that increases distance-from-origin is rewarded. Standing pillar stays present so the brain doesn't trade balance for speed. walk_target_velocity=0.05 is mild — the metric we care about is max_distance_from_origin accumulated over the rest of the run, not gait speed per se.

No skip_reset_on_entry — body is reset to centre when this stage starts so distance accumulation starts from 0 for clean cross-arm comparison.
